verdict.rationale: Airwallex is a financial platform (accounts, cards, payouts, FX), not an AI agent or host that consumes tools, so plugging external MCP servers into it is a category error. The evidence (AgentOS, developer connectors) shows Airwallex in the MCP server role, exposing its own tools to agents. That belongs to a separate story and does not show any MCP-client capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
